card.name: Inside long split-up words
card.fires_on: A piece in the middle of a long or rare word that is split into parts, such as the O in EMBRYO-FETAL, the ot in phenotyped or the hes in prostheses. It is strongest in the boxed warning heading EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY.

modes.label: Embryo-fetal heading
modes.description: The O inside EMBRYO in the capitalised EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY warning heading.

modes.label: Other rare words
modes.description: A middle piece of an uncommon word in medical or general text.
